articles.body:
Apologies if I missed this in the rules - checked several times first before asking this.

Example:   During the 4th turn the Company ruled Madras, Mysore and Hyderabad under the Madras Presidency.
Each had 2 unrest cubes due to Governor rolls.  The Madras Commander had 3 Officers and 4 Regiments, none had attacked this turn, so none were exhausted.  During India Events phase Hyderabad was attacked and defended successfully.   

  Question#1 - Would any of the Officers/Regiments have become exhausted from defending?    I really hope not!
  Question#2 - If yes to Q1, how many exhaust (attacker had 3 Towers + 2 unrest cubes = 5 total strength)?   I would think 5 (or none if NO)
  Question#3 - Would both Mysore and Madras now automatically rebel with strength = 2 unrest cubes each?
  Question#4 - The defender in both cases is the same Madras Commander units that were attacked by in Hyderabad, correct?
  Last Question (the one I dread):  If all regions with unrest cubes rebel, and there's no unexhausted Company defenders, 
          does that mean all rebelling regions are automatically lost?  

Thank you very much!

articles.body:
Question#1 - yes
Question#2 - you are correct
Question#3 - yes
Question#4 - yes
Last Question - yes

Getting rid of unrest cubes is very important for this very reason.

articles.body:
#1 Yes, you have to exhaust them to defend with them. You must exhaust pieces equal to the crisis strength, or as many as possible if you have fewer than needed.

#2 You must exhaust enough pieces to get 5 strength (officers give 1, regiments give 1, local alliances based on it's strength); if you don't have enough strength everything will be exhausted nonetheless.

#3 Yes, whenever there's an attack on the company EVERY region with unrest will rebel with a strength equal to the unrest cubes in the region.

#4 Yes, however if the commander fails to defend an attack it will be removed per the region loss rules.

#5 Yes. Remember that region losses "stack" meaning that if you lose 2 regions in a turn, the company standing would fall 3 spaces. If you lose 3 regions, it would fall 6 spaces.

Remember that region losses "stack" meaning that if you lose 2 regions in a turn, the company standing would fall 3 spaces. If you lose 3 regions, it would fall 6 spaces.</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
I wouldn't say its trivial to get rid of.  Its more likely you can get rid of it as it takes less units to roll a number of dice, since there is no defense to take dice away.

It has happened many times where with an army of  7 units, I exhaust 3 to remove a pile of unrest, fail, then have to exhaust the rest to try again, and be wide open to any future crisis.
